title: AoPS Wiki:Sandbox
text:
size(250);


pair O = (0,0);
pair P = (1,2);
real speed = 1.2;
pair V_end = P + speed * dir(-45);


draw(O--(3.5,0), Arrow(SimpleHead), L=Label("$x$", position=EndPoint, align=E));
draw(O--(0,3.5), Arrow(SimpleHead), L=Label("$y$", position=EndPoint, align=N));


draw((1,0)--P, dashed+gray);
draw((0,2)--P, dashed+gray);


label("$1.0\text{ m}$", (1,0), S);
label("$2.0\text{ m}$", (0,2), W);

draw(P--(P+0.8,0), gray);


path angleArc = arc(P, 0.4, 0, -45);
draw(angleArc);
label("$45^\circ$", P + (0.5, -0.2), E);


draw(P--V_end, deepgreen+linewidth(1.5), Arrow(SimpleHead));
label("$3.0\text{ m/s}$", V_end, SE);


dot(P, linewidth(5pt));
label("$200\text{ g}$", P, NW);
